messages:
olivia: Heads-up: UX question — when someone saves a 'route preset' in Console, should routing hints (region/capacity tier) be carried with org-level sharing? cc @kevin @maria
kevin: We need to decide for Hosted vs Dedicated. For Hosted, hints are harmless. For Dedicated/Private tenants, hints might leak customer capacity/region info.
maria: Yeah, privacy and KMS boundaries. Also affects automatic routing fallback when a model isn't available in the pinned capacity.
sam: From infra POV, if preset carries routing_hints it must be validated at read-time. We can't assume the same capacity exists for the opener.
kevin: Proposal: persist routing_hints but mark scope=private if it contains capacity tags. When sharing org-wide we replace capacity-specific tags with 'any' and keep region hints only if allowed.
maria: But 'any' will break cost/latency expectations. Customers expect saved views to reproduce results.
olivia: User expectation is reproducibility. Maybe we surface a small modal on open: show current effective routing and let user choose to 'pin' (attempt to use exact routing) or 'let platform resolve' (find nearest compatible capacity).
sam: Implementation idea: savedview schema adds routing_hints field with mode semantics. Example:
```json
{
  "route_id":"r_123",
  "filters": {...},
  "routing_hints": {"mode":"pin","preferred_region":"us-west-2","capacity_tier":"dedicated-small"}
}
```
kevin: Also should record original_preset_owner and a read-time resolution result so we can trace when opens diverge from saved behavior.
maria: Agree. Telemetry: when resolution happens, tag events with `preset_id`, `resolution_mode`, `resolved_capacity` and sample more aggressively for resolve flows. Metrics: `preset.resolve.count`, `preset.resolve.fail_rate`.
olivia: :thumbsup: Can we draft the modal copy? UX needs to explain SLA/cost differences between a pinned Dedicated capacity and platform-resolved routing.
sam: Quick copy suggestion: "This saved view pins routing to Dedicated capacity in us-west-2. Opening from another org may fail — choose to pin (use same capacity) or let Redwood pick a compatible capacity near you."
kevin: Edge-case: importing saved presets via API should accept both modes. API contract note: return 409 if a pin cannot be honored for the opener and the caller requested strict pin.
maria: Also add billing note: if a saved view pins a Dedicated model capacity, execution should bill to the capacity owner, not opener. Console should show a badge on the view: "Pinned capacity (owner: acme-corp)".
olivia: Ok action items: Kevin to draft API + schema RFC; Sam to draft backend validation and fallback flow; Maria to add telemetry metrics + alert hooks; I'll mock modal and microcopy and loop in design.
deploy-bot: deploy:flag updated savedviews-api v0.3 on staging — endpoints to test: POST /api/savedviews and GET /api/savedviews/:id
sam: I'll run e2e against staging tomorrow and add unit for the 'resolve' path.
kevin: :raised_hands: moving this to RFC stage, tagging `rfc/savedview-routing-hints`.
